name: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd
about: Kajaria Ceramics Ltd is primarily engaged in manufacturing and trading of ceramic and vitrified tiles in India.[1] It is the largest manufacturer of ceramic/ vitrified tiles in India and 8th largest in the world.[2]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
Their product portfolio includes ceramic wall & floor tiles, polished & glazed vitrified tiles, bath-ware solutions, and plywood & laminates. [1] In FY23, tiles accounted for ~88% of revenues while the rest of products accounted for ~12% of revenues[2]

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 45.2%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.5% over past five years.
